description: This file defines the SugarRestServiceImpl class, an implementation of REST services for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It extends a base web service class and adds a utility method for MD5 hashing.

classes.name: SugarRestServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for REST services, extending SugarWebServiceImpl and providing a MD5 utility method.

methods.name: md5
methods.description: Returns the MD5 hash of the input string.
